project.description: GCP only accepts project ID, not project number. If you are using number, you may get a "Permission denied" error.
project.security_impact: If the wrong identifier is used, deployment may fail or apply to the wrong project, leading to misconfigurations and potential security exposure.
project.rationale: Enforcing correct project IDs ensures the resource is deployed in the intended secure environment.
project.compliant: Project is set to a valid project ID (e.g., my-secure-project).
project.non-compliant: Project is set to a numeric project number or left unset.

location_id.description: Location where the app is served from.
location_id.security_impact: Improper region selection can violate data residency or compliance requirements.
location_id.rationale: Restricting location ensures data remains in approved regions.
location_id.compliant: Location is set to an approved region (e.g., australia-southeast1).
location_id.non-compliant: Location is left unset or uses a disallowed region.

auth_domain.description: Google Apps domain where users must belong to in order to access the app.
auth_domain.security_impact: If misconfigured, unauthorized users could gain access.
auth_domain.rationale: Restricting authentication to trusted domains enforces organizational boundaries.
auth_domain.non-compliant: auth_domain is unset or set to a broad/unrestricted domain.

database_type.description: Database type for App Engine (Firestore or Datastore).
database_type.security_impact: Improper selection may result in unsupported legacy databases or weaker data guarantees.
database_type.rationale: Enforce use of modern and supported database types like Firestore for reliability and security.

serving_status.description: Whether the app is serving or disabled.
serving_status.security_impact: Leaving an unused app serving could expose stale endpoints.
serving_status.rationale: Disable unused applications to reduce attack surface.
serving_status.compliant: serving_status = SERVING only when app is active.
serving_status.non-compliant: serving_status = SERVING for unused or test apps.

feature_settings.security_impact: Certain features could introduce security risks if not configured properly.
feature_settings.rationale: Explicit feature configuration ensures secure defaults.
feature_settings.compliant: feature_settings configured for security best practices.
feature_settings.non-compliant: feature_settings left empty or insecurely configured.

split_health_checks.description: Enables split health checks (readiness and liveness checks).
split_health_checks.security_impact: Disabling may reduce visibility into unhealthy app states.
split_health_checks.rationale: Health checks are needed for resilience and secure operations.

iap.description: Identity-Aware Proxy configuration for App Engine.
iap.security_impact: If IAP is not configured, apps may be publicly accessible without authentication.
iap.rationale: Enforcing IAP ensures only authenticated and authorized users can access sensitive apps.
iap.compliant: iap block is configured with client_id and secret.
iap.non-compliant: iap is not configured on sensitive apps.

oauth2_client_id.security_impact: If misconfigured, attackers could bypass authentication flows.
oauth2_client_id.rationale: Enforce valid OAuth2 identity provider integration.
oauth2_client_id.compliant: oauth2_client_id references a valid and secure client ID.

oauth2_client_secret.description: The SHA-256 hash of the client secret.
oauth2_client_secret.security_impact: Storing or exposing secrets insecurely may lead to credential compromise.
oauth2_client_secret.rationale: Secrets must be hashed and stored securely.
oauth2_client_secret.compliant: oauth2_client_secret is stored as a hashed value.
oauth2_client_secret.non-compliant: oauth2_client_secret is stored in plain text or unset.

notes: Full enforcement of App Engine application.json was not possible with the current OPA helpers. Path + domain validation logic requires extended pattern matching support.
